relationships.description: The permission is the grant that, once held by a principal through a role, allows the authorization layer to approve invocation of that specific action on its secure resource, supplying the permission side of the subject-verb-object access decision.
relationships.evidence: The security policy or authorization configuration (e.g. a permissions manifest, OPA/Casbin policy, or Spring Security @PreAuthorize expression) maps the permission's action-and-resource identifier to the operation declared on the secure resource, so the enforcement point checks that permission before allowing the operation.
